summary: Explains the need for a new pair of IANA Diameter Command Codes for a vendor-specific application, the ITU-T Q.3303.3 Rw interface, which carries requests to authorize network quality-of-service resources and policy enforcement. This is an informational document.

eli5.summary: A phone company needs a way to ask permission to give a call good bandwidth. This memo asks for two new numbers to label those request and reply messages.

questions: diameter command codes for qos policy enforcement
